name: – Bogdan Rzońca – § 17
title: REPORT on the annual report on the activities of the European Ombudsman in 2024
part_text: Stresses that Frontex’s primary mission must be the protection of the EU’s external borders, the control of human traffickers and coyotes, and the fight against illegal immigration; underlines that a lack of border control is what leads to more deaths at sea;
